lines.t: {{select_corps}}
At first we had the upper hand, sir.
The monster was clearly weakened, sir.
But then...
Suddenly the monster let out a roar, sir.

And the tide of battle turned in an
instant, sir!

Our {{medabot|pl}} suddenly stopped
listening to us
and began attacking us, sir!
Before long we were forced into
a full retreat, sir...!
{{principal|cap}}
What happened to Tenshin?
{{select_corps}}
Ten-- You mean the captain, sir? He

is armed and holding the front line with
the squad.

The captain intends to stake his life as a
breakwater.
Of course, we're prepared for that too.
While we hold them off,

everyone, please evacuate the island
quickly--
{{principal|cap}}
Nonsense.
